scope: Verifies that every fact preserved in data/canonical/names.json matches its source dataset exactly — data comparison only, no rendered HTML is inspected. Every entity (3,697) was checked on every dimension below; these are not sampled results.
method: For each of the 3,697 canonical entities, looked up the corresponding source row(s) in data/names.json, data/names-enriched.json, data/normalized-names.json, data/categories.json, data/variants.json, and data/popularity.json by name_id, and compared field-for-field (categories and variants compared as sets, since row order is not a meaningful fact to preserve; popularity compared both by count and by full row content).

checks.dimension: variants.spellingVariants[] (vs. data/variants.json, self-name excluded, compared as sets)
popularity.records[] (vs. data/popularity.json, row count + full content per row)

notes: This equivalence check exercises the SAME entities the build already produced (data/canonical/names.json) against the SAME source files the builder read from — it is not an independent second data source, so a passing result confirms internal consistency between the builder's output and its declared inputs, not correctness of the inputs themselves (which Phases 1A-1D already separately audited).
No rendered page, generator output, or HTML was inspected for this check — per the Phase 3A brief, this is a data-only comparison.
